mapper.sql: id,name,type,webhook_url as webhookUrl,secret,enabled,remark,create_time as createTime,update_time as updateTime
mapper.select:
select
from robot_config
and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') and enabled = #{enabled}
order by id asc

select
from robot_config where enabled = 1 order by id asc
mapper.insert: insert into robot_config (name, type, webhook_url, secret, enabled, remark, create_time, update_time) values (#{name}, #{type}, #{webhookUrl}, #{secret}, #{enabled}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
